title: House Varrow is founded
detail: Aldric Varrow raises the Iron Stag over the eastern ridge.

title: House Corvane is founded
detail: Ysolde Corvane raises the Black Raven above the marsh fort.

title: House Ashgrove is founded
detail: Wren of Ashgrove raises the White Oak.

title: Ysolde Corvane takes the throne
detail: House Corvane now holds the crown.

title: House Ashgrove swears fealty to House Varrow
detail: Wren kneels before the Iron Stag.

title: The crown sets its tax
detail: The tax of the realm is now 10.

title: House Varrow claims the crown
detail: Aldric Varrow names Ysolde Corvane a usurper and calls the banners. The rebellion window opens at dusk.

title: House Varrow rises
detail: The window of rebellion is open for two hours.

title: Odo the Tall names a ransom for Bramwell
detail: Bramwell of Corvane is held in chains. The price is 40 gold.

title: The ransom of Bramwell is paid
Bramwell goes free
detail: Bramwell is released after his ransom was paid.

title: The rebellion of House Varrow ends
detail: The throne held. Corvane keeps the crown, for now.

title: House Corvane and House Halloran sign a treaty
detail: Seven days of peace between the Raven and the Ember Hound.

title: House Halloran breaks its treaty with House Corvane
detail: Petra Halloran is marked an oathbreaker.

title: Ysolde Corvane no longer reigns
detail: Ysolde Corvane fell while holding the crown.

title: Aldric Varrow takes the throne
detail: House Varrow now holds the crown.

title: House Dunmere renounces its oath to House Ashgrove
detail: Dunmere now kneels to the Raven instead.

title: The King's Peace
detail: No blood may be spilled within the Crown Market until dawn.
